description: we are engineering a 3-layer spacesuit. The outer shield (1mm) features an innovative composite using recycled Biochar from Algerian forest fires, Optical Silicone, Nano-Ceramics, and Mylar. Physics simulation proves ultrafast ESD dissipation (<1.1 ms), outperforming NASA standards. Built using ultrasonic cutting and welding to ensure zero-leakage, complete astronaut safety, and absolute protection for high-value space assets.
